$comment: Acceptance corpus for the MK2 → MK3 converted extensions (OPUS-MK2-01 task B). Paths are relative to the MK2 checkout (MODKITX_MK2_ROOT, default ../modkitx) and are READ ONLY — no sample is ever copied into this repository. Every case is skipped when that checkout is absent, so CI without MK2 stays green.

entries.note: RIFF/WEBP container: simple, no native decoder, VP8/VP8L/VP8X chunk walk
MPEG-1 layer III frame header; v1 manifest routes on extension only
glTF 2.0 binary container; JSON chunk only, no buffer decoding
Tiberian Sun MIX with an unencrypted (checksummed) header
SVG root element; v1 manifest has no magic, so probe parses structure
CWS (zlib) SWF; the v1 codec claims header fields only, and so does this port
